fam.sub: Mu koya kuma mu yi wasa tare a matsayin iyali, da kulawa iri ɗaya ga sirri.
fam.girafinhas.d: Taɓawa uku, murya da launuka, ga wanda bai taɓa amfani da waya ba.
fam.tutor.d: Yana koyarwa mataki-mataki, ko babu hanyar sadarwa.
fam.quiz.d: Tambayoyi don wasa tare da iyali, ko tsakanin manya kawai.
fam.natal.d: Wasanni, samfuran takarda da takardar shaida don ajiyewa.
fam.video.d: Ɗauki bidiyo ba tare da intanet ba kuma ajiye shi da hatimi.
fam.contas.d: Yi lissafi kuma ajiye sakamakon da hatimi.
fam.regua.d: Shin har yanzu muna da lokacin ceton duniya?
fam.aventura.d: Wasan kasada don yin wasa tare.
